text:
incident-bot: PAGER: Redwood Inference - High error rate & latency spike on /v1/generate (hosted) - affected region: us-west-2. Paging on-call: @Maya Patel (primary), @Liam Chen (secondary). Please acknowledge. :rotating_light:

Maya Patel: ACK. jumping in. seeing alerts for KV cache memory growth + continuous-batching queue depth climb.

Liam Chen: I'm on call with Maya. initial graphs show sudden 5x token-latency for some customers starting ~1765432000.

Jordan Rivera: flagged by synthetic jobs too, some requests returning 502s from runtime.

Maya Patel: quick triage — is this the speculative-decode flag we rolled out yesterday?

Emily Zhao: yes we enabled speculative decoding + aggressive draft cache merging on a subset of capacity groups at 12:10 UTC (deployment id: deploy-7843).

Rahul Singh: looking at KV cache metrics: heap growth correlated with speculative-draft writes. keys/sec up 8x and evictions thrashing.

Maya Patel: logs for one hot pod: ```ERROR kv_cache: failed to insert draft key=abcd...: mem_overbudget -> try_evict -> loop must_replicate```

Liam Chen: also seeing continuous batching queue lengths spike -> big batch sizes then sudden divergence when draft<>target mismatch triggers replay.

Jordan Rivera: hypothesis: speculative decoding is writing transient draft KV entries that continuous-batching keeps referencing; when drafts get compacted or invalidated we get cache misses that force heavy recomputation -> batch amplification.

Emily Zhao: confirmed correlation: requests that exercised speculative path had 10-50x more KV ops. customers with long-context prompts hit it hardest.

Maya Patel: immediate mitigation options: 1) toggle speculative decoding off for hosted tier, 2) reduce max_batch_size and continuous batch window, 3) force a KV cache GC/flush on affected pools. Thoughts?

Liam Chen: priority = reduce customer impact quickly. I prefer toggling speculative decoding off globally for hosted until we have a patch. Safer than trying GC while traffic high.

Rahul Singh: we can also apply targeted traffic routing to move heavy customers to dedicated instances (if contracts allow), but that's slow.

Maya Patel: rolling back speculative flag to off now for us-west-2 staging and canary. will monitor.

deploy-bot: deploy started: toggle-spec-decode=false - target: hosted-us-west-2 - rolling 10 pods at a time - runbook: ops/runbooks/spec-decode-toggle.md

Liam Chen: on it. also lowering continuous batching window from 40ms -> 10ms for same pool to reduce batch amplification. launching as config patch.

Maya Patel: issuing hotfix: ```curl -X POST https://ops-api.internal/configs -d '{"pool":"us-west-2-hosted","speculative_decoding":false,"batch_window_ms":10}'``` (applied)

Rahul Singh: KV cache mem growth stopped climbing after flag toggle on canary pods. eviction rate stabilized.

Jordan Rivera: latency for affected customers trending back down but some 502s still visible — likely downstream replay fallout.

Emily Zhao: running targeted cache compaction on fully rolled-back nodes to reclaim fragmented memory: ```/usr/local/bin/kv-compactor --pool hosted-us-west-2 --mode incremental```

Maya Patel: customer impact summary so far: ~12 customers in us-west-2 experienced elevated latencies (2-8s extra p50->p95) and ~6 had intermittent errors (502). No data loss reported.

Liam Chen: mitigation status: speculative decoding disabled (rolling), batch window reduced, compaction running. Recommend keeping hosted toggle off until root cause fixed.

Jordan Rivera: can we reproduce locally? I have a test harness with long-context prompts to simulate: will run with draft/target mismatch injection.

Emily Zhao: good. I'm adding a regression alert for KV ops per-request and batch-muliplier metric.

Maya Patel: handoff plan: I'll stay on for 30 more minutes then hand to @Liam Chen for overnight monitoring. create incident channel notes and start RCA doc.

Liam Chen: ACK handoff. I'll keep a watch on canary and full pool rollout status; if error rate > 1% revert batch window back to 40ms and re-enable safe-mode that directs heavy requests to lower-concurrency path.

Rahul Singh: action items captured: [EMILY] add KV ops per-request alert, [JORDAN] reproduce with harness, [LIAM] monitor rollback + overnight, [MAYA] start RCA skeleton.

Maya Patel: quick note for postmortem: include timeline, speculative decode interaction with KV cache, batch amplification math, and test coverage gap.

deploy-bot: deploy complete: toggle-spec-decode=false - 100% canary -> 0 errors on canary after 3m -> continue rollout to remaining pods.

Liam Chen: full rollout complete. metrics look stable 15m after rollout. keeping incident open for 3 hours for post-deploy stability window.

Jordan Rivera: repro harness showed cache divergence when speculative draft writes were not atomically pinned with target stream; we'll add a locking step in the write path as a safe-change candidate.

Emily Zhao: drafting alert runbook update: add runbook step: "if KV ops spike + batch depth rise: disable speculative_decoding and lower batch_window_ms".

Maya Patel: handoff note -> I'm off now. leaving postmortem draft at https://redwood-internal.incidents/rca/1765432100 (please fill). @Liam Chen will own follow-ups. thanks all :heart:

Liam Chen: taking over. will push follow-ups and schedule a deeper debugging session tomorrow with runtime + ML infra + serving teams. closing in-channel updates but keeping thread pinned to incident doc. :eyes:
